messages:
alex: Created new GCP project redwood-gcp-uk-prod-2, need quota changes before we can bring up inference nodes in europe-west2. filing now.

miriam: what quotas do you need? also cc @sachin for cost ok.

alex: Requested quotas in ticket: GPUs - L4: 40, H100: 8. IN_USE_ADDRESSES: 30, Forwarding rules (global): 20. Shared VPC: rw-infra-vpc. Billing account: redwood-prod-billing. Jira INFRA-4523. Reason: EMEA inference pilot for low-latency routing.

sachin: rough cost check: if we land 8 H100 + 40 L4 used ~50% we might see ~ $30-40k/mo. I can provisionally approve the spend for a short pilot, but want monitoring and an automatic alert if daily spend exceeds $5k. :thumbsup:

jess: Network notes — provisioning will need additional static external IPs and a couple of forwarding rules for LB testing. Also need a temporary ingress rule for SSH from our office IPs during setup. I put a checklist in the ticket.

alex: Copy of ticket body we sent to GCP support: ```Hello, project redwood-gcp-uk-prod-2 requires GPU quota increases in europe-west2: L4: 40 GPUs, H100: 8 GPUs. Please also increase IN_USE_ADDRESSES to 30 and global forwardingRules to 20. Project uses Shared VPC rw-infra-vpc and will attach compute service accounts svc-quotas@redwood.com and provisioning@g.redwood.com. Billing account redwood-prod-billing. Purpose: inference fleet pilot for EMEA, low-latency model serving. Please advise expected time to fulfill and any alternatives (H100v2, A100 80GB).```

infra-bot: Ticket GCP-0123456789 created (severity: production-impacting). Assigned to quota-team@gcp.support. Expected initial response within 24-48h.

miriam: Can you add the billing owner and the org domain to the ticket? GCP often asks for org-level approval.

alex: Added billing-owner@g.redwood.com and org domain redwood-inference.com to the support ticket. Attached cost breakdown and usage projections.

jess: Proposed provisioning window: tonight 23:00 UTC for initial node bootstraps and firewall rule changes. Will need a short maintenance notice.

sachin: 23:00 UTC works for me. Approving temporary egress increase and firewall tweak for the window. If GCP can't grant H100s in europe-west2 they offered H100v2 as an alternative — acceptable provided performance parity.

alex: Noted. I asked GCP to include H100v2 equivalency in the response. Will post updates here when ticket status changes.

miriam: Thanks — please also add an alert runbook for tokenized model failures and cost spikes.

alex: will do, adding INFRA-4523 -> runbook link once created.
